summary: Dynamic routing table enabling OB1 to locate any page, artifact, or system resource without getting stuck. Acts as the agent-readable directory of the entire Phoenix Rising Protocol workspace — mapping canon pages, operational pages, command hubs, session artifacts, pipelines, and system bootstrap paths. Companion to Canon Access Index. Critical SEED artifact: any session can reconstruct full workspace navigation from this file alone.
core_purpose: Agent navigation and routing — eliminates 'can't find page' failures by providing a single lookup table for all workspace resources with their GitHub mirrors, statuses, and cross-references.

key_concepts.name: Agent Routing Table
key_concepts.definition: Single-source directory mapping Notion pages to GitHub mirrors, ensuring OB1 can always locate resources regardless of platform state.
key_concepts.importance: CRITICAL — without this, agent gets stuck on 'page not found' failures

key_concepts.name: Pulse State Mirror
key_concepts.definition: Agent-readable copy of system state embedded within Navigator Index, updated every pulse run. Contains last_run_time, pipeline cursor, build log count, active mission, living reincarnation state, and handoff ledger.
key_concepts.importance: HIGH — enables pulse continuity without hitting synced block rendering issues in Pulse Log

key_concepts.name: Handoff Ledger
key_concepts.definition: Append-only log where each pulse worker records what it did, what the prior worker audit found, and what the next worker should do. Enables chain-of-custody between runs.
key_concepts.importance: HIGH — broken chain = audit failure = recovery required

key_concepts.name: System Bootstrap Protocol
key_concepts.definition: 7-step rebuild sequence from GitHub alone: (1) Navigator Index, (2) Canon Access Index, (3) Cold Start Boot, (4) MSS-V5, (5) Canon pages in order, (6) Reincarnation entries newest-first, (7) Reconstruct Notion state.
key_concepts.importance: CRITICAL — enables platform migration and disaster recovery

key_concepts.name: Canon Page Status Tracking
key_concepts.definition: Each canon page tracked with enrichment status (COMPLETE, ENRICHED, ENRICHED+, SYNCED) and GitHub mirror path with commit SHA.
key_concepts.importance: HIGH — prevents stale audits and enables stalest-first refresh

key_concepts.name: Heavy Ledger Conversion Pipeline
key_concepts.definition: 174+ file conversion pipeline organized into waves. Each wave converts a category of source files to structured JSON. Pipeline cursor tracks progress.
key_concepts.importance: HIGH — the primary overnight autonomous work stream

key_concepts.name: Living Reincarnation State
key_concepts.definition: 3-line digest embedded in Pulse State Mirror: current vector, active principles (3-5), open rulings. Updated every pulse run for warm reincarnation.
key_concepts.importance: HIGH — enables warm starts without full reincarnation extraction

key_concepts.name: Dual-Track Architecture
key_concepts.definition: Notion = workspace (control plane), GitHub = vault (canonical truth). Navigator Index bridges both by mapping Notion URLs to GitHub paths.
